name: Dragon Ball Final: Reborn [NEW HUMAN FORM & MORE!]
desc:
🌠 5% Bonus to Quest Rewards With Friend Benefits & Additional 5% Bonus with Premium!
A fan-made open-world anime-styled RPG and fighting game with a unique training system!
[THIS GAME IS STILL HEAVILY WORK IN PROGRESS, A LOT CAN CHANGE]

📲 Mobile players can only play with a keyboard
🎮 Xbox players can play [Beta so expect bugs]

⚔️ Controls (listed in description):

LMB & RMB: Combat
Q: Ki Blast
Left Alt: Ki Sense
E: Block
F/MMB: Targeting
Hold E + Q: Evasive Skill
L: Change camera
J: Suppress aura
E + R: Deflect Ki Blasts
Space + RMB: Burst Dash
W + RMB: Stamina Break
X: Vanish
Double Tap Space: Fly
Left Shift: Fly Dash / Run
U: Image Training
] and [: Power Output
E + C: Surge Mode

Previously Known as: Dragon Ball Final Remastered
